description: This source file defines the 'SriLankaComplianceService' class which provides various baseline methods for Sri Lanka-specific tax and statutory reporting. It includes functions to generate VAT returns, income tax schedules, WHT statements, EPF/ETF reports, and annual financials, predominantly interacting with a database and returning reports suited for multi-tenant accounting systems.

classes.name: SriLankaComplianceService
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods for Sri Lanka-specific compliance reporting within an accounting system, supporting VAT, income tax, WHT, EPF/ETF, and financial statement generation.

methods.name: getVatReturn(companyId, options = {})
methods.description: Calculates VAT Return summary including output VAT, input VAT, net VAT, zero-rated and exempt sales, optionally including transaction details, for a specified period and company.

methods.name: getIncomeTaxSchedule(companyId, options = {})
methods.description: Provides a baseline profile for income tax calculation, including profit before tax from the books, adjustments, and computed tax due based on a configurable corporate tax rate.

methods.name: getWHTStatement(companyId, options = {})
methods.description: Generates a Withholding Tax statement summary and optional transaction details, categorizing WHT by type based on account naming heuristics.

methods.name: getEPFETFReport(companyId, options = {})
methods.description: Produces a report on EPF/ETF contributions for a given period, estimating based on payroll expenses accounts if ledger data is incomplete.

methods.name: getAnnualFinancials(companyId, options = {})
methods.description: Aggregates annual financial data mapped to Sri Lanka Companies Act categories, optionally comparing current and previous years.
